integrity: Exact finite source code is included, and the analytic proof specifies its assumptions and classical moment inputs; numerical enumeration does not certify asymptotics.
scientific_limitations: Dimension is fixed at d>=2; coordinate marginals independent continuous; refresh replaces whole vectors by independent draws. The result does not establish arbitrary-coordinate-noise or correlated-coordinate persistence; the refreshed-only error is an upper order bound. Independent verification and exhaustive priority review have not occurred.
title: Poisson persistence of Pareto maxima under independent sample refresh
